title: New Balance SuperComp Elite V5 $104.50 + Shipping ($0 with $150 Spend) @ Running Warehouse
body:
Deal: New Balance SuperComp Elite V5 $104.50 + Shipping ($0 with $150 Spend) @ Running Warehouse

[john240] Stacks with RUNNING15 for an extra 15% off down to $88.83, thanks!
[BargainsGrabber] Never fails, always check for comments :D
[DealHunted] And that too from someone who has had three comments in 3 years! Silence is golden?!
[Dealr] yes appears to have been patched. No codes working on this shoe now that I can see. Even the generic mail codes. Incredible price regardless, but a sign that this bargain wasn't meant for me.
[ratmanuwu] I'm glad the Size Chart button works so I can easily find what width and length to get for my foot
[carlosthedwarf] Super Comp Trainer V3 and Rebel v3 are $104.50 too
https://www.runningwarehouse.com.au/New_Balance_FuelCell_Sup…
https://www.runningwarehouse.com.au/New_Balance_FuelCell_Reb…
[TurnipHead] The Rebel v5 is tempting (I don't need carbon plated super shoes)
[Liberian] Don't think the coupon is available for the v5
[badadatdatda] @Liberian: yeah coupon doesnt work on the rebel v5 unfortunately
[looky-here] great shoe, my favourite shoe in my rotation at the moment
[G-Shock] Cheap.. Those colourways though.. got the rebel v4 in the stealthy black.
[Haydos90] Been eyeing these at 50% off for months but hadn't pulled the trigger. Absolute no brainier at this price, thanks OP!
Great to see a shoe like this available in a size 14 too
[DernKala] New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v3 is also on sale: https://www.runningwarehouse.com.au/New_Balance_FuelCell_Sup…
Great long run shoe, great shock absorption
[dealsucker] Thanks for the recommendation. Went with this one
[UNFKNBLVBL] Those are my tempo training shoes, I use 1080's for most of my running, like gliding on cloud's….
[G-Shock] Or the 860 for those who overpronate (like nimbus neutral, Kayano stability).
I can go either way, haven't tried the 1080 v15 but heard good things. These look alright $140
https://upthereathletics.com/products/new-balance-mens-fresh…
Got some Nike vomereo plus, crazy comfort and height.
[chickenteriyaki] I've had the opposite experience where the pair I received were incredibly stiff and firm with no flex, even after 50km's of trying to break them in - I gave up and ended up selling them.
[Soled Out] Anyone know how they fit? True to size or half a size up? Thanks in advance.
[RAndyMelb] I've got one pair of NB and the size for me fits the same as asics and nike.
[bisaya] are any of these worth a shot for someone that overpronates?
I usually get stability shoes but at these prices these are tempting lol
[SKS01] I guess you may consider SC Trainer v3.
https://www.runningwarehouse.com.au/New_Balance_FuelCell_Sup…
SuperComp Elite V5 is less stable.
[alecator] Stick with what you know suits your biomechanics
[carlosthedwarf] Rebel v5 is way too soft IMO unless you're neutral.
[Fitzwah] V5's have been fantastic for me and I don't love squishy shoes. I hated ASICS nimbus for example.
[carlosthedwarf] I've had both and enjoyed them. V5 feels a lot less stable to me though, but I like that softness and don't over pronate though.
[bisaya] @carlosthedwarf: thanks all. leaning towards sc trainer v3 atm after doing some reading.
im not a huge fan of super soft/squishy tbh.
[supergolf10] These are race shoes so they wear out quicker as they’re all foam soles but still good
[linkser] I flicked through a few reviews before checkout, seems like they survive ~300k and the soles are actually quite durable. You break-in the carbon plate before wearing of the sole it seems.
[linkser] Ooooh that was too tempting. Nowhere near fast enough atm but hey just need a new pair for new motivation.
[JDearyMe] Great price!!!
Just for anyone thinking these would be good as a regular shoe; absolutely not. They have a carbon plate and 0 stability. Race day and MAYBE tempo work only. Do not get these for everyday walking.
Have a pair and they take ~20 seconds off my regular pace per km. Love em
[Duece1995] What about the Rebel V5 for everyday use?
[JDearyMe] If it's not the new rebel then it's okay. I'd go 1080s personally
[Fredfloresjr] 2000+ clicks and all sizes still avail. Good luck running warehouse.
Thanks OP tho, hope they honour. 20+ pairs of running shoes will never be enough.
[amsaini15] Would "Brooks Adrenaline GTS 25" be ok for a teenager to uni? He likes slightly colourful comfy shoes. Can running shoes be daily wear shoes for him?
[DernKala] Does your son have pronation issues? The GTS line is generally for people that have stability issues
[gamer9119] Are there stability shoes for flat feet on sales? Cheers
[akanian] Amazing pair of shoe, I bought a pair recently at 50% off. Just bought another pair. For carbons, these are actually quite durable and the foam isn’t crazy soft like some others. I prefer these over vaporfly 4s or adios pro 4s
[SKS01] All models here are running shoes. Buy gym shoes for the gym.
[ChairmanMeow] I don't need another race day shoes. I don't need another race day shoes. I don't need another race day shoes. I don't need another race day shoes.
[zestylemon] Ordered one and a New Balance FuelCell SuperComp Trainer v3 for $177 and free delivery, absolute steal thanks!
[ironworthy] Did anyone get an order number? There was none after payment screen and none in the order confirmation email they sent. Order history is empty.
[Lord_Sif] It says on order history it may take 24 hours. Didn't get one either but I presume it'll come up.
[braddsey] If only I didn't just get a new pair of $800 orthotics that is making me rethink every pair of shoes I own and my current standard sizing. :(
[Fredfloresjr] Good morning, 6000 clicks and all sizes still available.
Staff this morning will be very busy sending cancellation emails 🤣🤣
[super-zero] Can these shoes still be used for regular walking or jogging?
